name: Onii-chan to Watashi
source:
My older brother is a kind man who always takes care of me.
Recently, I'd moved into his home.
...Wait? Something about him seems a little... off?

[Translated from [url=https://novelgame.jp/games/show/13575]Novelgame[/url]]
